trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing here needs online play, DLC or a difficulty setting, so a single playthrough is enough. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and puts the platinum at about 200 hours, most of it on the 100%-completion gold. In practice the last trophy you earn is usually A Long Road, so treat the roadmap stages as the platinum route and tick trophies off as you go.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable: it unlocks when the other 54 are done.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 through to its end and the trophy pops. It is a straight story trophy: there is nothing to prepare, no side objective to watch for and no way to miss it. If you are following the roadmap, this is the first tick on the board.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes the trophy is awarded as Chapter 2 begins, after its first mission, What's in the Bag? Just keep playing the story and it comes to you; it cannot be missed. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that might matter later: the morning after Down to Earth, accept Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. PowerPyx notes the trophy lands as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City. It is automatic and cannot be missed, so just play through. Chapter 2 is where the world opens up: after Coffee Break you can switch characters and free-roam as a pair, which unlocks the partner trophies and the side lines the roadmap starts in stage 2.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes the trophy is awarded once Chapter 4 is under way, after its first two missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. It is automatic and cannot be missed. Chapter 3 is also where several side lines start — Andy, Randy and Tyrone — so check the roadmap's stage 2 steps before you push on into Chapter 4.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. PowerPyx notes the trophy unlocks after the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. It is automatic and cannot be missed. Chapter 4 also holds the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which unlocks the bank-vault robberies behind Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play — do it when it appears rather than leaving it for cleanup.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final story mission through to the credits and this gold pops. It is automatic and cannot be missed, and it is one of only two golds in the set. PowerPyx places the final mission at the end of Chapter 4. Before you start it, make a manual save: there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so a save before the finale is your only way back.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It is an automatic story trophy that pops during the mission, so there is nothing extra to do and no way to miss it. Breakfast Run is also the mission after which Billy's Thrillbilly Mudclub line opens, so the roadmap picks up a side strand right after this tick.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It pops automatically during the mission, so just play it through; it cannot be missed. The heist is one of the bigger set pieces of Chapter 3, and finishing it is also a natural moment to check the roadmap's stage 2 steps before Chapter 4.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It pops automatically during the mission, so there is nothing to prepare and no way to miss it. Chapter 4's missions come thick and fast from here, and the next three story trophies all land in this chapter, so keep playing and they stack up on their own.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It is an automatic story trophy that pops during the mission, so play it through and it cannot be missed. Nothing about this trophy needs a side objective or a particular approach — the mission itself is the requirement.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It pops automatically during the mission, so there is nothing extra to do and no way to miss it. The mission's airport setting is worth remembering later: the VCIA terminals are also where Catch Me If You Can is earned, once you are free-roaming after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops automatically during the mission, so play it through and it cannot be missed. This is the last of the named-mission story trophies, and after it only the final mission and the chapter trophies remain on the story side.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100% checklist after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and finish it. The list is lenient — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion — and progress made during the story already counts. A few lines need everything: all robberies including the 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations, all underwater discoveries, every shooting-range gold, all drone races and all 15 Target Decks. The rest ask for a share only: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and it is the hardest trophy in the set, so expect most of the platinum's 200 hours to land here.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx and GTABase: everything on the checklist is doable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps, and you can mix them freely to reach 250. PowerPyx calls the under-bridge flights the quickest to knock out. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where completed stunts stay marked by name. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if the platinum is the goal.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: stunts stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), playing an arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt. GTABase lists the same nine, and you can check your count under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. Most of them come up on their own while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so PowerPyx advises not to chase this one specially — just let it pop as you play.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: activities stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every shooting-range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges, as GTABase confirms. PowerPyx links a full locations guide for all 12 ranges, and the ranges are worth visiting early anyway, since shooting practice raises your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. There is no shortcut — each challenge needs its own gold — but the gold thresholds are forgiving, and the 100% checklist needs all 42 too, so this is a trophy you finish once and never revisit.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: shooting ranges stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy, as GTABase confirms, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so it pays to finish every race at a location while you are there instead of coming back. PowerPyx links a guide to all 14 locations and all 42 races. Drone races are a self-contained activity, so this is a clean cleanup trophy once the story is done.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: drone races stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations to choose from, and winning the same race twice does not count, as GTABase confirms. PowerPyx links a guide to all 40 race locations, so pick the shortest and easiest ones and work through them. Races also feed Master of None and the 100% checklist, so this one tends to fall out of the same sessions as Top Fun.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: races stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he will text you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline from there and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing is also one of the nine activity types for Master of None, so this trophy does double duty. There is no time limit on the questline, so you can pick it up whenever the text arrives.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: Cal's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, and Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best — it does not matter which one you finish. The home games are available from Chapter 1, though they can be temporarily unavailable during some story sections.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: arcade games stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all five of Andy's quests, which are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3: at some point while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville that marks the questline on the map. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass, and the trophy pops after the last one. All of Andy's quests stay available after the story, so there is no rush — but note Andy's line does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks silver.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: Andy's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line: after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked by a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you to dive shipwrecks, marking purple treasure-chest icons on the map; find the treasure on the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back to him. He wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in total, in sets — turn in one set and he calls you back with more. Track progress under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes away after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2 to 3, so do not worry if he vanishes for a while; playing as Jason and calling Brian in Chapter 2 can hurry his return text along.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: Kenton returns in Chapters 2-3 and his quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all five of Billy's quests. The line is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. The quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes, and the trophy pops after the last one. All of Billy's quests stay available after the story. Like Andy's line, Billy's does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks silver.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: Billy's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count, and PowerPyx's live guide names the four confirmed ones with their missions: Kirk (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries: Southpoint Airfield, Pete's Deliveries: Avery Allen & Co., Deliver Packages). PowerPyx warns that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers for this trophy, and a second side-mission guide adds Shirley to the non-counting list. Four more counting strands are still being discovered — PowerPyx says so outright — so this entry stays partial: finish the four confirmed strands, watch the trophy tracker after each strand's last mission to see whether it moved the counter, and treat any strand that does not move it as a non-counter. Every stranger strand stays available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: Strangers & Freaks stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver the 16 sports cars he wants. The line starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner; that first car counts as delivered. Randy marks cars for you in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage (green RK icon in the west of Vice City). Delivering a car in good condition pays more. The wanted cars turn up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around, and new marks appear as you complete the ones he gave you. This can all be done after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: Randy's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's two quests, which are Jason-only and start after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for the Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — the trophy pops after it. Everything here stays available after the story, and like the other named side lines, Tyrone's does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks silver.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: Tyrone's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Lucia and Jason at a spot counts as two, so you can only finish the last one once both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Now the warning: the first meditation is only available during Chapter 1, at Jason's house. The morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That session raises the counter by one but is not marked as a meditation spot like the others, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — its author had done it when the trophy popped. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe, and keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.
trophies.missable_note: POSSIBLY MISSABLE per PowerPyx and GTABase: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house is gone after Chapter 1, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it. Do it the morning after Down to Earth.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His line is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him as Jason. His first quest also gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more, but that is optional. Track the line on the map under Activities, then Target Deck: there are 15 Target Decks in total and the 100% checklist needs all 15, so the trophy rides along with work you have to do anyway. This entry stays partial for one honest reason: PowerPyx's live guide still says it is undergoing confirmation which animal exactly triggers the trophy. Work Bret's whole line through and it should come with it; the line stays available after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not known to be missable: Bret's quests stay available after the story per PowerPyx; the exact triggering animal is still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total, so you only need three of them — pick the sets whose cards are closest together and work those first. PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 set locations. Cards are a pure collectible hunt with no story gate, so this is a good trophy to fold into the map-unfogging runs for The Goodtime State, and it can be finished entirely in free-roam after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: card sets stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app on your phone to scan 100 locations. Hold up on the D-pad and then R1 to scan whatever you are looking at: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, and PowerPyx breaks the pool down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures plus the No Flusher tags, so there are well over 100 to choose from. Any 100 will do, and the 100% checklist wants 100 WAiNK scans too, so this trophy and the checklist line finish together. Scanning is also how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good, so fold the two together on every drive.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: WAiNK locations stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there and you can skip the hardest ten entirely. View and track challenges under Progress, then Challenges — a completed checkmark shows in the bottom right as you scroll over each one. PowerPyx advises leaving this for late: a lot of challenges complete naturally while you work on the other trophies, and once the easy ones are banked you can pick the quickest remaining ones to close the gap.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: challenges stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle. Getting to 4 stars is easy: cause enough carnage until the fourth star lights up. Then escape in a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic to leave the search area; if a helicopter is chasing you, shoot it down until it leaves. PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy unlocks once you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank-vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: it unlocks automatically during the Chapter 4 bank-vault missions if not earned earlier.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. You need the pair free-roam unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle. Then hit 3 robbery targets (green icons on the map) while staying chased the whole time — keep the red and blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each store, get into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs. If you leave the first store before the police arrive you may need a fourth shop, and the pop is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: shops stay robbable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes — and the fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy pops on the way to that bigger number.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: vehicles stay scannable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but it drains the purple focus bar and only lasts a few seconds. First buff your focus by eating, drinking, or washing your face and showering at home, and take Adrenaline to stretch the slowdown (hold L1, then press triangle). Then line up 5 enemies — PowerPyx suggests the criminals at gang operations — and drop them quickly without missing, using an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 and wearing body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick gang enemies. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and it gets easier as you level it, so this often pops naturally late in the run.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: Combat Focus and gang operations stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, the Vice City International Airport. It has to be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — the planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest is the one at departure terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for it, then use the stairs next to the boarding bridge, where a door leads directly into the plane. Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops, slightly delayed. You can also walk in through the airport terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: VCIA stays accessible in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so go in with full health and body armor and do not linger once you are rolling.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: Mile Zero Air Station stays accessible in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry-store robberies on the map with green icons in unfogged areas. Then break into a store through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently, and approaching a locked door gives you the choice to kick it (which triggers the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside, look in the back room for a note with the safe code and use it to loot the safe. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good first target.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: jewelry stores stay robbable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — go in while it is open and rob it, bringing your partner along to carry a second bag (hold right on the D-pad to hand one off). After that mission you can pay Yasmani, the fence unlocked in Chapter 3, $10,000 per tip about security vans; do his earlier quests first if you have not (robbing 2 Payday Loans). Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the trophy needs any 5, but the 100% checklist wants all 8, so it pops on the way. Vaults pay up to $205,000 each, making this the best money-maker in the endgame.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: bank vaults stay robbable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: robbing a bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank and the guard carries the cash to the vault — enter the vault, steal the cash and escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray. There is also an earlier method: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks, so block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are found in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani unlocks as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. You need all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist anyway, so this trophy usually pops on its own.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: armored trucks and bank vaults stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx links a guide to the best plane for the job. Unfogging also reveals activities and collectibles on the map, so do it early in cleanup — it makes every other hunt in this guide faster, from card sets to WAiNK locations.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: the map stays unfoggable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, but the trophy needs only one per gang; the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way there. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Keep track under Progress, then Gangs, where scrolling over a gang shows in the bottom right how many of its operations you have robbed. PowerPyx links a guide to all 39 locations if you want to plan a route instead of stumbling on them.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: gang operations stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — and that is now a cross-checked fact, not a gap in our research. PowerPyx's live guide still lists this trophy as currently unknown, Push Square's work-in-progress guide lists it with no method at all, and the SixShore list marks its exact method as not yet confirmed. All three agree on the only hard facts: the official description, enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Nothing cited says which bar, which drink or which spot triggers it, so this entry will not invent one. If you want to experiment, Ocean Beach is the named place and ordering a cocktail there is the literal reading of the description — but treat that as your own experiment, not a confirmed method. This entry will be updated the moment a launch-era guide confirms the trigger.
trophies.missable_note: Method unconfirmed as of 2026-11-19 — missability cannot be judged until the trigger is known.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a specific car from a specific showroom and drive it through the showroom window. The car is the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, and only that blue Banshee counts — no other car triggers it. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, so hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the window. The pop is slightly delayed and comes after you drive further away on the street. PowerPyx notes it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: the showroom and Key Cloner stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the gang operations in Port Gellhorn. Before you go, buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe. You first go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, pick up the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. It is not missable: if you do not get all 3 during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for the remaining valuables.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: the Kingpin Bowling robbery icon respawns, so remaining valuables can be collected later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start once you can switch between both characters, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Check each character's strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then scroll to Strength (the heart icon). Raise it by working out: buy a membership at a fitness club and always go together with both characters — call your partner with right on the D-pad plus triangle — because while you actively work out with one character, the other completes their training automatically, doubling your progress. Filter for fitness clubs on the map under Activities (the dumbbell icon); there are plenty all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: fitness clubs stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can watch the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and PowerPyx recommends turning on criminal-profile notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On, so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something counts. The profiles run from Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and finally Irredeemable — which is permanent, so avoid pushing into it, since cops will shoot on sight. Most players get this passively while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, because every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it is still short at the end, PowerPyx says you can farm it quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: criminal-profile actions keep counting in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. PowerPyx's live guide still lists this trophy as currently unknown, adding only a belief — its word — that it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The SixShore list repeats the same suspicion and also marks it unconfirmed, and Push Square's work-in-progress guide offers no method. So the Payday Loans link is a shared guess between guides, not a verified trigger, and the official description, Second time's the charm, only hints at a repeat attempt at something. One practical habit costs nothing: the prologue's Payday Loans store is early-game, so keep a manual save from the prologue (the roadmap already asks for chapter saves) in case the trigger turns out to live there and cannot be revisited. Beyond that, do not chase the guess blind; this entry will be updated when a guide confirms the trigger.
trophies.missable_note: Method unconfirmed as of 2026-11-19 — missability cannot be judged until the trigger is known.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO Easter egg — this method was confirmed in PowerPyx's live guide on 19 November 2026, after round 2 of this guide was written, which is why earlier versions called it unknown. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. The trigger is a car parked at the roadside with its lights blinking; the spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed, so if the car is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Park up, then follow the path beside the car into the woods, where a UFO hangs in the sky as a bright blue light. Approach it and it drops a woman it had abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside — the trophy unlocks as the encounter completes. Two conditions matter: come solo (leave your partner behind) and come after 2AM; arriving in daylight or with company does not start it.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: the UFO encounter is a repeatable free-roam event (night, after 2AM, solo) and stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. PowerPyx's live guide still lists this trophy as currently unknown, adding only a belief that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. GTABase reads the official description the same way — knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — and also says the exact steps are not confirmed yet. So both cited guides agree on the shape of the thing (a melee drive-by, most likely the motorcycle kick) and neither has verified the precise conditions: how many enemies, whether they must be knocked down in one pass, or whether a car works as well as a bike. If you experiment, a motorcycle among gang enemies is the best-supported guess, and the attempt costs nothing in free-roam — but this entry stays unconfirmed until a guide verifies the trigger, and it will be updated when one does.
trophies.missable_note: Method unconfirmed as of 2026-11-19 — missability cannot be judged until the trigger is known.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer so marked bills can be laundered at all. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, so you do not need to bring it in one trip, and it comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist. Bank vaults are the richest source, up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: fences stay available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the most expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. There is no shortage of places to spend it — PowerPyx counts 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. The total is cumulative across every shop, so it builds up on its own while you gear up for the rest of the platinum; by the endgame it is usually already done.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: shops stay open in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages. They cost $160,000 in total, and they become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone — you buy the garages through the app. The 4 story-related garages do not count for this trophy, only the 8 you buy. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4, and PowerPyx links a guide to all 12 garage locations. Buying garages also adds parking spots, which you need for On the Spot.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: garages stay purchasable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, and it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. To register 10 you first need enough garages — see Little Boxes — because each garage adds parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, click Respray and Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes if you want to keep the bill down.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable per PowerPyx: Scooter Bros registration stays available in free-roam after the story.

meta.note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published 2026-11-18 (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze), cross-checked across PowerPyx, GTABase and Planet GTA 6. Guides are written in our own words from the cited guides; nothing is copied. Round 3 re-checked every open entry against PowerPyx's live guide, GTABase, Push Square and SixShore on the evening of 19 November 2026: The Truth Is Out There is now verified (PowerPyx published the full UFO Easter egg method), leaving 50 guides verified, 2 partial (Strangers & Freaks — four counting strands confirmed, more still being found; Fair Game — the exact triggering animal is still unconfirmed) and 3 unconfirmed (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, Ten Pin) — those entries say so instead of guessing.
